decisions.why: the row's example "Madamn Professional Wax Spatulas" is a dental lab wax-modelling instrument, which is what dental:equip (chairs, handpieces & lab) covers
the row's example "Conical Measure Glass | 25ml" is a pharmacy dispensing measure, which is pharmacy equipment
the row's example "Appeel Spray Aerosol" is a medical adhesive remover used for stoma appliance and dressing removal, which ostomy:acc covers as skin care
every example is a Greyland Machine Dishwash or Concentrated Machine Dishwash product, i.e. cleaning chemicals
the warranties are sold against the named seca CT331, CT330, Cardiopad-2 and CT8000p-2 ECG recorders, which are diagnostic cardiology equipment

I read all 33 products against Farla's live storefront this run: every one is a Bed Alertamat bed-exit alarm mat or the plug adaptor that connects it to a named nurse-call system (Quantec, Courtney Thorne, Medicare MTM6022), which is falls/nurse-call telecare, not bed furniture
the Actineb nebuliser accessory pack and MEDIX Nebuliser Outlet Filter are aerosol-therapy consumables
the Compact 3 Chair is a wheeled patient transit chair while the BabyPod 20 items are an infant transport pod system, two genuinely distinct lines in one division
Portex Blue Line Endotracheal Tubes, tracheostomy inner cannulas and an endotracheal stylet are airway and breathing-circuit consumables
"Linked Raiser For Furniture with Castor" is a bed and chair height-raiser block, a standard occupational-therapy daily living aid
"Flip A Grip" is an anti-slip ice attachment fitted to walking sticks, a walking-aid accessory
"Denture Container | 250ml" is a personal hygiene care item
"VernaGel Super Absorbent Powder" is a body-fluid spill-gelling product used in clinical cleaning
"Shield Probe Wipes" clean and disinfect ultrasound transducer probes, a transducer accessory
"Instillaquill" is a uterine instillation device used in family planning procedures
"Cavilon No Sting Barrier Film Spray" is a skin barrier product, the same skin-care line as this supplier's Adhesive Remover row
"Clinell Spill Wipes" are clinical surface decontamination consumables
KarriCart is a clinical trolley system and the tray is a clinical-trolley accessory
"External Folding Trolley Structure for Bags" is explicitly a clinical trolley structure
